subject: Webinar recording & streaming: consent language, platform roles, and tech rehearsal
messages:
From: Emily Nguyen <emily@acme.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: ON24 Support <ops@on24.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Webinar: Scaling with LLMs — recording & streaming logistics

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for offering to host this joint webinar. A couple of logistics items from Acme's side before we confirm final RSVP copy and the session run-of-show: 

- Recording & sharing: Acme policy requires explicit consent from presenters and a written agreement on who can access the recording after the live session. Can Redwood record and provide a copy restricted to Acme internal use for one week, after which the recording should be unpublished unless we agree otherwise?
- Registration fields: please include company size, job function, and an explicit marketing opt-in checkbox.
- Streaming: our events team prefers ON24 but can fall back to Zoom streaming if needed. We need to know if Redwood can supply an ON24 producer or if Acme must provide a co-producer.
- Captions: live captions are a requirement for this audience — can Redwood/ON24 enable captions?

Attaching our standard webinar request form for reference.

Appreciate a quick run-through of roles and a draft consent text we can review.

Best,
Emily Nguyen
Event Lead, Acme Corp
emily@acme.com | (415) 555-0198

Attachment: acme_webinar_request_form.pdf (PDF, 240 KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Emily Nguyen <emily@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Webinar: Scaling with LLMs — recording & streaming logistics

Emily — thanks for the clear list. High level answers and next steps below; Marissa and Ava will fill in registrant copy and the tech runbook.

1) Recording & distribution: We're fine recording the session. Proposed approach: Redwood will record and provide Acme a private download link (unlisted) for 7 calendar days. Redwood marketing may request permission to reuse the recording; any reuse beyond the 7-day internal access window would require explicit written permission from Acme. If that works for you, I'll send a short consent doc for signature.

2) Registration fields & opt-in: Marissa will propose exact field text; we can include company size, job function, country, and a separate marketing opt-in checkbox.

3) ON24 vs Zoom: We can support ON24 and provide a producer at an extra operational fee; otherwise, Acme can give us co-host/producer rights. Ava will propose the tech rehearsal schedule and list the producer responsibilities.

4) Captions: ON24 supports live captions; if we use Zoom we will enable live captions as well. Confirm which platform you prefer and we'll finalize.

I've attached a quick draft of recording consent language and a roles spreadsheet to make responsibilities explicit.

Next steps:
- Marissa: registration copy + consent checkbox text (by EOD Monday)
- Ava: tech runbook + rehearsal slots (by EOD Monday)
- Emily: confirm preferred platform (ON24 or Zoom) and whether you'd like Redwood to provide a producer.

Thanks — talk soon.

--
Karthik Iyer

On Fri, Apr 10, 2026 at 9:12 AM Emily Nguyen <emily@acme.com> wrote:
> Thanks again for offering to host this joint webinar. A couple of logistics items from Acme's side before we confirm final RSVP copy and the session run-of-show:
> 
> - Recording & sharing: Acme policy requires explicit consent from presenters and a written agreement on who can access the recording after the live session.

Emily — below are the registration fields and proposed consent language we recommend. Happy to iterate.

Proposed registration fields (required):
- First name, Last name
- Work email (company email only)
- Company name
- Company size (dropdown: 1-10, 11-50, 51-200, 201-1000, 1001+)
- Job function (dropdown)
- Country
- Marketing opt-in (checkbox — "I agree to receive emails about Redwood/Acme events and product updates")

Proposed recording consent wording (checkbox, required for live presenters):
"I understand that this webinar will be recorded. The recording will be made available to Acme Corp for internal use for 7 days after the live session. Any distribution or external use of the recording by Redwood requires written permission from Acme Corp."

Optional attendee-facing text (below registration form):
"By registering, you consent to being included in event attendance lists shared with Acme Corp and Redwood Inference. Transcripts and recordings may be generated; please contact events@acme.com for privacy requests."

I'll add these to the event page template and share the public RSVP link once Ava confirms the platform.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Events Program Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

> Streaming: our events team prefers ON24 but can fall back to Zoom streaming if needed. We need to know if Redwood can supply an ON24 producer or if Acme must provide a co-producer.

Hi all — technical checklist and proposed rehearsal times below. I'm recommending we run ON24 as primary and Zoom as fallback (we'll publish fallback instructions to attendees only if we need to switch).

Tech checklist (ON24 primary):
- Redwood provides ON24 producer (we'll handle slide ingestion, panelist mics, captioning toggle).
- Acme to provide co-producer access for brand controls and Q&A moderation.
- Live captions: enable ON24 auto-captioning + optional human captioner (we can add if needed).
- Recording: ON24 will produce a VOD file. We'll host the unlisted link on a secure page and hand over access to Acme for 7 days.
- Stream key rotation: generate new keys on the day of rehearsal; do not reuse keys across events.

Tech rehearsal windows (please confirm one):
- Tue, Apr 20 — 10:00–10:45 PT (preferred)
- Wed, Apr 21 — 14:00–14:45 PT

Producer roles (summary) — detailed runbook attached:
- Redwood Producer: scene switching, recording start/stop, slide ingest, captioning toggle, streaming failover to Zoom
- Acme Co-Producer: co-host chat moderation, approve branding slides, confirm speaker order

Action item for Acme: confirm preference for ON24 + whether Redwood should provide producer support (there is a nominal fee which Karthik can outline).

Attachment: tech_rehearsal_runbook.md (MD, 18 KB)

--
Ava Chen
